reason: I already stop at a supermarket on my way home from Jounieh, and Tawfeer MAX is five minutes from my house. Half of the bulk saving minus $1.25 a bag is probably a few dollars at best, so I don't see why I would hand my list to someone else.
objection: How do I know they really paid the cheap price and didn't add a markup? A slip is only paper, and the saving is small once the bag fee comes off.
would_change_my_mind: A guarantee that I always save more than the bag fee, shown on the first two slips, and a neighbour I know vouching for them.
